name: net.nextcv/cv-tools
title: NextCV CV Tools
description: Free, rule-based CV checker and CV-to-job keyword matcher. No AI, no signup, nothing stored.

tools.name: check_cv
tools.description: Scores a CV from 0 to 100 on structure, contact details, dates, length, bullet quality and ATS-friendliness, and lists the most important problems with a fix for each. Takes the CV as plain text. Rule-based and deterministic: no AI is used, nothing is stored, and the text is not kept after the call. It checks formatting and conventions, not whether the person is a good fit for a job, and no score guarantees an interview. Returns a link to the free checker on nextcv.net.

cvText.description: The full CV as plain text.

locale.description: Language of the CV and of the reply: en, sv or fr. Defaults to en.

tools.name: match_cv_to_job
tools.description: Compares a CV with a job ad and returns a 0 to 100 keyword match score, the ad's keywords the CV already contains, and the ones it is missing (skills and tools flagged separately). Takes both as plain text. Rule-based and deterministic: no AI is used, nothing is stored. It measures wording overlap only, not experience level or whether the candidate would be hired. Returns a link to nextcv.net where the CV can be tailored to that ad.

cvText.description: The full CV as plain text.

jobText.description: The full text of the job ad.

locale.description: Language of the CV and of the reply: en, sv or fr. Defaults to en.
